title: Indian Pilot Stabbed on FlyDubai Flight Recalls Sudden Attack
summary_full: Capt. Smit Machchhar, who was stabbed by his co-pilot midair between Dubai and Tel Aviv, said he “had to act” to prevent a crash despite serious injuries.
